ideas.pitch: Reimagining asynchronous design collaboration by transforming messy Figma comment threads into an interactive, timeline-based storyboard where feedback directly maps to specific design version states.
ideas.title: ChronoCanvas: The Async Figma Comment Redesign
ideas.why_it_could_win: Targeting the core UI/UX design focus of Redefine with an innovative interaction model for a familiar tool (Figma), directly appealing to design-heavy judges.

ideas.pitch: An accessibility-first browser extension that redesigns standard web pages into spatial, audio-first narrative layouts instead of linear text-to-speech scraping.
ideas.title: AudioLens: Spatial Screen Reader for the Visually Impaired
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines creative problem solving with an impactful human-centered design approach, which heavily sways judging panels looking for meaningful real-world utility.

ideas.pitch: A design system and interactive prototype that replaces infinite scroll mechanics in social apps with deliberate, episodic consumption checkpoints.
ideas.title: ScrollZero: Mindful Mobile App Redesign System
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly challenges familiar digital product mechanics from the ground up, aligning with Redefine's specific challenge to question how digital products work.

ideas.pitch: A dynamic typography tool for digital interfaces that automatically adjusts font weights, optical sizes, and tracking based on ambient lighting and reading distance.
ideas.title: TypeOS: Context-Aware Visual Micro-Typography Engine
ideas.why_it_could_win: Showcases meticulous attention to visual design details and typography, which stands out in a 24-hour designathon crowded with standard UI mockups.

ideas.pitch: An experimental note-taking and idea-mapping interface built around multi-touch spatial gestures rather than cumbersome toolbar clicks.
ideas.title: NodeFlow: Gesture-Driven Canvas for Non-Linear Thinking
ideas.why_it_could_win: Presents an entirely new interaction model for productivity software, directly fulfilling the designathon's prompt to think beyond conventional design.
